item.title: Govt Orders IndiGo to Clear All Refunds by 8 PM Sunday; Imposes Zero Rescheduling Fees
item.description: Government orders IndiGo to refund all disrupted passengers by Sunday amid 1,000+ cancellations from crew shortages and FDTL rules.

item.title: “She Can Stay For As Long As She Wants”: FM Jaishankar on Exiled Sheikh Hasina Living in India
item.description: India’s External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar affirmed on December 6, 2025, that the indefinite stay of former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina remains her personal choice, following her flight from Dhaka amid deadly 2024 protests that ended her 15-year rule. The 78-year-old former leader is currently living in India despite an extradition demand from the […]

item.title: IndiGo Flight Chaos Grips Airports as DGCA Suspends Pilot Duty Rules Amid Crew Shortages and Delays
item.description: IndiGo's crew shortages from new pilot rest rules led to over 1,800 cancellations, prompting DGCA to suspend norms and government to mandate passenger aid until operations stabilise.

item.title: India Announces Free 30-Day E-Tourist Visas for Russians, Boosting Ties Post Putin-Modi Summit
item.description: India's free 30-day e-tourist visas for Russians promise smoother travel and stronger bilateral bonds after the Modi-Putin summit.

item.title: NYC Mayor-Elect Zohran Mamdani Urges Millions of Immigrants to Know Rights, Stand Up to ICE After Chinatown Raid Protest
item.description: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani guides immigrants on ICE legal rights after Chinatown raid protesters block federal deportations.

item.title: Filmmaker Vikram Bhatt, Wife Arrested in Mumbai for ₹300 Crore Fraud Linking Udaipur Businessman Films
item.description: Rajasthan police arrest filmmaker Vikram Bhatt and associates following allegations of cheating Udaipur IVF doctor through false film investment promises.

item.title: At Least Ten Fishing Boats Gutted in Massive Fire at Ashtamudi Lake in Kerala’s Kollam District; Probe Ordered
item.description: A pre-dawn blaze reportedly fuelled by exploding gas cylinders destroyed at least 10 fishing boats in Kollam.

item.title: India May Merge 12 Public Sector Banks into Just 4 by 2027 – Govt Says No Active Proposal
item.description: India’s ongoing public sector bank consolidation aims to create globally competitive lenders ready to fuel growth.

item.title: Goa Nightclub Fire Kills 25: Fifth Accused Held in Delhi, Club Owner Issues First Statement; CM Announces ₹5 lakh Ex-Gratia
item.description: 5th arrest made from Delhi in the Goa nightclub fire that killed 25 including staff and tourists. Read more.

item.title: “Paid Rs 18,000 for the Work of Three”: Viral Staff Letter Exposes IndiGo Meltdown After 500+ Cancellations
item.description: A viral letter from IndiGo staff reveals years of ignored warnings and management failures fueling over 500 flight cancellations amid DGCA scrutiny.
